Caffè Latte

The classic. Espresso and milk. Smooth, creamy and coffee-forward.

For: the coffee purists.

Spanish Latte

Espresso, milk and condensed milk. Rich, creamy and on the sweeter side.

For: those with a sweet tooth.

Kyoto Latte

A lighter take on our Spanish Latte, with less condensed milk and just a hint of sweetness.

For: those who like it sweet, but a little less sweet.

Dark Latte

Espresso, milk and rich Valrhona dark chocolate.

For: when you can’t choose between coffee and chocolate.

Matcha Latte

Matcha from Uji, Kyoto, blended with milk. Smooth and earthy.

For: when coffee isn’t the mood.

caption:
​Old Chang Kee just launched their brand-new Pop A Corn Tots, and I went down to grab a cone right on launch day! 🌽✨

​Is it popcorn? Is it a tot? It’s actually bite-sized real baby corn deep-fried into golden fritters and served piping hot in a cone for easy holding 🤚

​Here is my honest taste test breakdown
----
​🌽 Texture & Taste Review:
• Freshly fried, super light, and extremely crispy on the outside! Ideal to eat while it's piping hot becaude the batter become soggy when it cools.
• The baby corn inside is unmarinated, keeping its natural vegetable sweetness and crisp freshness.
• The real flavour hit comes from the savoury, well-seasoned batter.

It gives off a kind of popcorn-style snacking feeling, but with the juicy bite of real baby corn inside. Extremely addictive whether you're sharing or polishing off the whole 12 pieces of bite sized corn in a cone yourself! 🤭
​
This is a limited time only item from 7 to 31 October 2026. 
​📍 Available at all Old Chang Kee outlets islandwide (also on GrabFood & foodpanda). 

​⚠️ Note: It’s Halal-certified, but not vegetarian-friendly as the seasoning contains dried shrimp and oyster powder. 

​Head down to your nearest outlet to try it before it’s gone at the end of the month! 🌽

alt: Photo by Aya & Alan | MY SG Foodie & Travel 😋 on September 05, 2026.
caption:
🇸🇬🐈🐈‍⬛ @oldchangkeesingapore 
Finally, the 𝐒𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐄𝐠𝐠 𝐓𝐚𝐫𝐨 𝐌𝐨𝐜𝐡𝐢’𝐎 is back at 𝐎𝐥𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐊𝐞𝐞 as their Mid-Autumn special! My hubby bought it for me during their previous launch, and I’ve been missing it ever since. 🌕💜✨

🥮 𝐒𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐄𝐠𝐠 𝐓𝐚𝐫𝐨 𝐌𝐨𝐜𝐡𝐢’𝐎 ($𝟑.𝟖𝟎 𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 / $𝟔.𝟖𝟎 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝟐)
Loaded with rich taro paste and savoury salted egg, with chewy mochi in the middle, all wrapped in their buttery golden puff pastry. The slight saltiness from the salted egg balanced the sweetness of the taro really well, while the mochi added that satisfying chewiness. ⭐️

If you’re an Orh Nee lover like me, I definitely recommend giving this a try while it’s back! I’m just glad I can finally satisfy my craving again. 💜😋

Available for a limited time only! Try them now! ✨🌕🐇

[Halal]
📍 Available at all Old Chang Kee outlets

Tea Time Lah! 🫖✨ When heritage meets modern flair, you get this iconic collaboration between Madison’s and Old Chang Kee to celebrate Old Chang Kee’s 70th anniversary!

@madisonsonhill.sg x @oldchangkeesingapore have teamed up to reimagine Singapore’s beloved local street food classics into a stunning afternoon tea set.

Here’s a look at what was on the menu:

🥠 Sidewalk Savouries
Chilli Crab Puff – A mandatory nod to Old Chang Kee’s legendary pastry game!
Laksa Prawn with avocado, blinis & laksa leaf – Rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced.
Satay Chicken Tartelette with puffed rice – Big local flavor in a delicate, crispy bite.
Seaweed Cracker with shredded egg, green mango salad & cincalok – Super refreshing with a punchy zesty kick.
Mini Black Sesame Ball & Vegetable Spring Roll

🥭 Sweet Fun
Nasi Lemak Scone – A mind-bending, savory-sweet spin that somehow just works.
Curry Corn Mousse & Dark Chocolate Chili Canelé – Bold, adventurous fusion done right!
Ondeh Ondeh Mousse & Pulut Hitam Mousse with coconut crunch – Creamy nostalgia in a bite.
Red Bean Mochi Tart, Yuzu Macaron & classic Heritage Almond Cookies.

caption:
🏕️🍛 CAMPING + CURRY = THE ULTIMATE COMFORT FOOD! 🤤🔥

Who says you can’t have a delicious bowl of curry while camping? 😍

During my camping trip, I brought along @oldchangkeesingapore Curry Paste and turned it into a super easy and comforting bowl of Curry Ee Mian! 🍜🍛

The best part? So convenient, so flavourful and absolutely delicious! 🤤 No need to pack a whole bunch of curry spices — just bring the curry paste, a few simple ingredients and you’re good to go! ⛺️

👨🏻‍🍳 My Camping Curry Ee Mian

🛒 Ingredients:
• 1 packet Old Chang Kee Curry Paste
• 600ml water
• 500g chicken thighs
• 400g potato cubes
• 150ml evaporated milk
• Ee Mian or rice

🔥 How to cook:
1️⃣ Mix 1 packet of curry paste with 600ml water and bring to a boil.
2️⃣ Add chicken thighs and simmer for 10 mins.
3️⃣ Add potato cubes and simmer for another 15 mins.
4️⃣ Add Ee Mian, stir in 150ml evaporated milk and bring to a gentle boil.
5️⃣ Serve hot and enjoy! 🤤🍛

Perfect for camping, road trips or even a quick meal at home! 🙌🏻

💰 Old Chang Kee Curry Paste — $5 per pack

alt: Photo by Aya & Alan | MY SG Foodie & Travel 😋 on July 10, 2026.
caption:
🇸🇬🐈🐈‍⬛ @mcdsg x @oldchangkeesingapore 
𝐌𝐜𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐝’𝐬 ✖️ 𝐎𝐥𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐊𝐞𝐞 has officially dropped their National Day collaboration, and as curry lovers, we were so excited to give it a try! 🇸🇬🍛✨

Here’s what we ordered.

🍔 𝐃𝐨𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐏𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐁𝐮𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐫 𝐒𝐞𝐭 ($𝟏𝟐.𝟐𝟎)
This was surprisingly good! The chicken patty was crispy and different from the usual McSpicy, while the curry potato filling was rich, fragrant and reminded us of Old Chang Kee’s signature curry. Definitely our favourite. ⭐️

🍟 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐌𝐜𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫 𝐅𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐬
If you love Twisties Curry flavour, you’ll probably enjoy this. It has a similar savoury curry seasoning and goes really well with the fries.⭐️

🥧 𝐏𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐮𝐭 𝐏𝐢𝐞
Filled with juicy pineapple chunks and fragrant coconut filling. Not overly sweet, making it easy to finish. ⭐️

💛 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞 𝐁𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 (+$𝟓.𝟖𝟎 with any meal)
This instantly became my hubby’s favourite. Now he wants to put it on everything! Definitely worth grabbing if you’re a fan of McD’s curry sauce. ⭐️

🍠 𝐒𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐭 𝐏𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐨𝐜𝐡𝐢 𝐁𝐚𝐥𝐥 ($𝟐.𝟖𝟎)
Ordered as our snack! Crispy outside, chewy inside with a fragrant purple sweet potato filling. Not too sweet and surprisingly addictive. ⭐️

If you’re a curry lover, this collaboration is definitely worth checking out. We’re already looking forward to trying the upcoming 𝐑𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐁𝐞𝐞𝐟 𝐁𝐮𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐫 next!

alt: Photo by % ΔRΔBICΔ Singapore on August 28, 2025.
caption:
Today is our founder Kenneth’s 55th birthday. To celebrate, we asked him three questions.

Q1. You launched % Arabica in 2013, and this year marks twelve years. How would you describe the journey so far?

“It has been a non-stop rollercoaster. We opened our first store in Hong Kong in 2013, and the following year, wanting to honor my roots, we opened in Kyoto to make it a Japanese brand.

Since then, franchise requests have come from all over. We chose partners carefully, opened each store with care, and step by step grew to 230 stores.

There have been both highs and lows, but I’ve never stopped moving forward. Today, as I turn 55, I believe that steady progress, one step at a time, will continue until I retire.”

Q2. Where do you find the energy that keeps you moving forward?

“I grew up in Tokyo, and at 18 moved to Los Angeles for university. I fell in love with Manhattan Beach — the rows of beach houses fascinated me.

One evening, watching the sunset, I saw kids playing in the sand until their mom called them in for dinner. Tears filled my eyes. I thought, ‘What an unfair world.’ But at the same time, a hungry spirit awoke — a vow to one day build a life as rich as theirs. That fire still burns in me.

For 30 years I’ve worked with focus and persistence every day. Seeing such stark differences in wealth gave me the hunger that shaped my journey. For that, I’m grateful.”

Q3. What kind of brand do you want % Arabica to become over the next ten years?

“Recently I began working with a creative agency in Paris. After interviewing our core team, they said: “% Arabica seems to carry a deep Japanese cultural essence.”

I replied: “In Japan, we have traditions like Sadō (Way of Tea), Kadō (Way of Flowers), Shodō (Way of Calligraphy), Jūdō, Aikidō. Each is a path — a dō. I studied calligraphy when I was young, and % Arabica is also a kind of Coffee-dō — the Way of Coffee. At its core, it’s about self-discipline, simplicity, and enriching life through coffee.”

This realization was profound. Over the next ten years, I want us to keep exploring and defining our unique path — The Way of Coffee.”

alt: Video by Victor Lim on February 06, 2026.
caption:
Ring in the Chinese Lunar New Year with bold flavours and auspicious delights as Old Chang Kee welcomes the Year of the Horse with a festive favourite and a new creation. From 2nd February 2026, the Dendeng Bak Kwa Chicken’O returns to all outlets, joined by the new Trio Nian Gao Spring’O, adding extra joy to the season of reunion.

First introduced in 2022, the Dendeng Bak Kwa Chicken’O makes a highly anticipated comeback with a new recipe crafted for the Year of the Horse. The sweet-savoury puff is filled with smoky BBQ dendeng chicken bak kwa, crunchy water chestnut, sweet corn, carrot, and spring onion, lightly seasoned with chilli and black pepper. The water chestnut, 马蹄, symbolizes good fortune and strength, especially fitting for the horse year. Each piece is stamped with one of four auspicious characters – 興, 旺, 發, and 财 – representing luck, prosperity, growth, and wealth, adding meaning to every bite. Priced at S$3, it will be available until 3rd March 2026, both in-store and via delivery platforms like GrabFood, Deliveroo, and foodpanda. Halal-certified, it’s a treat everyone can enjoy. 

Adding a touch of sweetness, Old Chang Kee introduces the Trio Nian Gao Spring’O, a new festive delight designed to bring loved ones together. This crispy spring roll combines three flavours: sticky rice (nian gao), yam, and sweet potato, delivering a satisfying chewy-crispy contrast. Vibrantly coloured, it symbolises harmony, abundance, and sweetness for the year ahead. Priced at S$2.30 each, it will be available until 3rd March 2026, while stocks last, and can also be enjoyed via delivery platforms.

Together, these offerings embody the spirit of renewal and prosperity, making this Lunar New Year a season of meaningful celebration.
